title: Omaha, NE — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Omaha, NE: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Omaha is a city in NE with a population of 485,153. Warren Buffett’s hometown with a thriving tech sector and rock-bottom cost of living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
